title: Query question file
description: A file in query/ is a JSON list of write-a-query questions (EPL for IN5040), typed in the code editor and checked against the model query. Needs oral.query in course.json. Checked by `npm run check` (server/oral/bank.js mirrors these rules).

id.description: Unique across oral/ and query/, always starting with 'oral-', e.g. 'oral-l03-q10'. Never reuse or rename an id: ratings are stored by id.

type.description: Optional; every question in query/ is a query question.

topic.description: Exactly one of the lecture names in course.json.

prompt.description: The task: what the statement must output. Sub-questions go on their own lines as 'a) …', 'b) …'.

code.description: The streams/event types and their fields, shown in a monospace block (\n for new lines).

hints.description: Revealed one at a time, each more specific than the last. The last hint still must not give the full query away.

keyPoints.description: What a correct statement must get right (window, filter, aggregates, pattern...), one point each. Used as the self-check list and as the grading rubric.

modelAnswer.description: The model statement, without a trailing semicolon.

alternatives.description: Other acceptable statements, e.g. a where instead of a stream filter.

followUps.description: Questions an examiner would ask about the statement.

seconds.description: Suggested answer time. Query practice is untimed; only used if the question is shown in oral mode (modes.query off).

source.description: Where it comes from, e.g. 'Lecture 3; H25 mandatory Esper assignment'.

coverage.description: slides (default) if taught, pensum if only in the reading list.
